svg.title: ADR-0016 concept: seed 7 street network today and as proposed (drawn, not built)
svg.text: ADR-0016 concept: the seed-7 street network (v3 plan), today and as proposed
Schematic: positions to scale (1 px = 2.03 m), line widths not. Street names are invented.
Street types (colour and line style both differ)
Civic avenue, 36 m (2 + 2 lanes, 10 m median)
One-way street, 13 m (2 lanes one way, arrows)
Market lane, 13 m (old town, no cars)
Repeated stops over 75 s, measured; larger is more (today)
Signalled walk crossing, headquarters to court (proposed)
Today: seed 7, tick 288, sim v3 (tests/fixtures/sim-v3-seed7-t288.json.gz), drawn from the renderer’s own cityLayout and kindAt; markers from 10 minutes of headless traffic.
Proposed: walks become night-market streets, mid streets beside them one-way pairs, built-over halves shared streets. Nothing here is implemented.
